item.title: Star gymnast earns a spot in the record book on the vault
item.description: In the first meet of the 2025-26 season, senior Grace Murray engraved her name into Ithaca College gymnastics history, tying the program record vault score with a 9.800 score Jan. 10 against SUNY Brockport. Murray added her name in the record book next to Carolyn Nichols ’19, who surpassed the previous mark in 2018. item.description: There is much to be angry about within this country, and that anger being expressed is a logical path. But while language is powerful, words can only do so much.
